plain.li: I could fly, but only a hand's width off the ground. Still the best night I've had in years.
Flew over the colony last night and saw how small it is from up there, every window dark.
Dreamt I could fly by leaning into the wind, like swimming. I went out over the river and back.
[child] I could fly! I went right over the grown-ups' heads and they couldn't catch me.
[old] Flying, all night, and my knees didn't hurt once. I didn't come down till morning.
[winter] Last night I went south with the birds, all the way to somewhere it's always spring.
[tribal] I was a hawk in my dream, riding the warm air over the hunting grounds. I could see every rabbit.
[spacer] Flew without a ship last night, out past the moons, with nothing between me and the stars.
[trait:Wimp] I flew away from everything, up where nothing could reach me.
[again] Flying again. I'm getting better at the landings.

warm.li: In the dream I took people up one at a time to see the view from above the clouds.

blunt.li: Dreamt I could fly. Back to hauling.

cheerful.li: I flew! Loops over the kitchen roof, right past the chimney.

gloomy.li: I could fly until I was halfway up and remembered that I can't.

cold.li: A flying dream. The physics were wrong, but I enjoyed it anyway.

plain.li: Had to speak before the council in my dream, and I'd forgotten every word. Then my teeth started coming loose.
Dreamt I'd been put in charge of something important, and no one would tell me what, and I was already late for it.
In the dream I walked into the council meeting with no clothes on, and they went right on talking about grain.
[newcomer] In the dream there were rules here that only I didn't know, and I kept breaking them.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] I was holding up the roof with one hand all night, and my arm was shaking.
[teen] The adults gave me the keys to everything and left, and I spent the whole dream trying doors.
[again] I had the speech dream again, the one where every word goes out of my head.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was supposed to do something and didn't. Woke up and checked. I did it.

cheerful.li: Had a dream I gave a speech in my underwear, and they clapped! I can't stop laughing about it.

gloomy.li: Let them all down in my dream. Didn't take much imagining.

cold.li: An ordinary anxiety dream. Late for something, teeth coming loose. I've had it before.

plain.li: Did {SKILL} all night long in my sleep. I'm more tired than when I lay down.
In the dream I was doing {SKILL} for someone I couldn't see, and every time I finished there was more.
[skill:Mining] Digging all night, and the rock kept whispering that I was nearly through.
[skill:Cooking] The pot had no bottom. I kept ladling and the line never got any shorter.
[skill:Plants] Dreamt the potatoes followed me up and down the rows, waiting to be planted.
[skill:Construction] Built a wall all the way around the world in my sleep, one block at a time.
[skill:Crafting] Sewed the same shirt over and over all night in my sleep, and the sleeves never came out the same length.
[skill:Medicine] I was stitching up a patient who kept saying it didn't hurt, and I couldn't find the wound.
[skill:Animals] Milked the same cow all night. The bucket never filled and she never ran dry.
[skill:Intellectual] In the dream I finished the research, and the answer was written in a script I couldn't read.
[skill:Artistic] I carved the same statue all night, and every time I stepped back it was a block of stone again.
[skill:Shooting|skill:Melee] I dreamt I was on guard, and the night lasted a hundred years, and nothing ever came.
[skill:Social] Stuck in a conversation that never ended, nodding along while the candles burned down.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] A dream about work. That's the worst kind there is.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] Worked all night in my dream. Best sleep I've had in a week.

blunt.li: Work dream. Then work.

cheerful.li: Dreamt every job in the colony was done and we all went swimming!

gloomy.li: Even in my dreams I'm hauling something.

cold.li: Spent the night doing chores in my head. A poor use of sleep.

plain.li: Dreamt I could understand the chickens. All complaints, mostly about the rooster.
There was a thrumbo asleep in my bed, so I slept on the floor. It snored like a landslide.
A boomalope stood up at dinner and gave us all a long talk about fire safety. It was very thorough.
[skill:Animals] Walked through the forest, and every animal I met knew my name and wanted its ears scratched.
[child] I had an alpaca small enough to fit in my pocket, and it came everywhere with me.
[tribal] The animal spirits came and sat with us, and the great elk told the story of the first hunt.
[winter] In my dream the muffalo let me sleep between them where it was warm. They smelled awful and I didn't care.

warm.li: Every animal we've ever tamed came to see me, one after another, nosing at my hands.

blunt.li: Animal dream. They were fine. I was fine.

cheerful.li: Rode a giant squirrel through the treetops last night! Best dream I've had.

gloomy.li: The animals were talking about us. None of it was kind.

cold.li: Dreamt I understood what the animals were saying. They're as foolish as I expected.

plain.li: In the dream the colony was burning and they were all asleep. I shouted until my throat gave out and not one of them stirred.
Carried water to the fire all night, and every bucket was full of sand when I got there.
[summer|hot] Dreamt the grass caught fire and came at us like a wave. I can still smell the smoke.
[winter] We lit a fire to keep warm, and it got hungry and started on the walls.
[child] I dreamt there was fire in the hallway and it was laughing at me.
[again] The fire again. This time I knew where the water was, and I still didn't get there.

warm.li: Had a fire dream, and I got every one of them out. I counted heads twice.

blunt.li: Fire dream. Checked where the water is. Not taking chances.

cheerful.li: I beat out a fire with my hat in my dream!

gloomy.li: Dreamt the colony burned to the ground. I stood and watched it go.

cold.li: A dream about fire. I'll check how long it would take us to put one out.

plain.li: A centipede walked through the colony, very politely, checking our names off a list.
Dreamt the machines were digging under us. I could hear them through my pillow.
I was one of the machines in my dream, walking in step with the others, and I couldn't stop.
[tribal|medieval] Iron spirits with no faces, walking in a line, and the ground hummed where they stepped.
[spacer] Dreamt the hive had already won, and I was the last one who hadn't noticed.
[again] The machines again. They're closer this time.

blunt.li: Mechanoids, all night. Hate those things, awake or asleep.

cheerful.li: Dreamt a scyther tried to give me a haircut! It did a terrible job.

gloomy.li: In the dream the machines didn't bother attacking. They stood out past the fields and waited.

cold.li: The mechanoids were assessing us, in the dream. I expect they are.

plain.li: The moon came down and sat in the field. It was warm, and it hummed like a cat.
Dreamt the sky was an ocean and a huge shape was swimming in it, just above the clouds.
[rain] Every raindrop had a voice, and they were all saying the same word. I can't get it back now.
[snow] In the dream the snowflakes were as big as plates and made no sound when they landed.
[fog] The fog was a crowd of people, all looking for the same door.
[storm] Caught a lightning bolt in a jar and kept it under my bed.
[clear,night] Lay on the roof counting stars, and every one I counted went out.
[spacer] I could see the ship that brought me here, still up there, going around and around.
[child] The clouds were sheep and I was the shepherd. One of them got away.

warm.li: Dreamt we all lay in the grass watching the sky change colors, with nowhere we had to be.

cheerful.li: The sky was full of kites, thousands of them, each with someone's name on it!

gloomy.li: I dreamt the sky was a lid, and someone was about to close it.

cold.li: Dreamt the stars had moved. I checked them before dawn, to be sure.

plain.li: A pie as big as a door. We had to eat our way out of the kitchen.
Dreamt of fresh bread so clearly I could smell it. I'm hungry and happy.
[trait:Gourmand] Twelve courses in my dream, and I tasted every one. Breakfast is going to be a letdown.
[trait:Ascetic] All I dreamt of was a bowl of plain rice. It was enough.
[poor] In my dream the larder was so full we had to wedge the door shut with a chair.
[winter] Summer berries, still warm from the sun. I can still taste them.
[child] There was a room made of sweets, and I ate the doorknob first.
[tribal] Last night I dreamt of a great hunt and the meal after, with the fat dripping into the fire and the singing going late.
[spacer] Had a meal from home in my dream, real food, not printed. Grilled fish and something green.

warm.li: Dreamt I cooked for the whole table, and they all came back for seconds.

blunt.li: Food dream. Now I'm starving.

cheerful.li: There was a cake taller than me, and I climbed up and ate the top!

gloomy.li: Roast meat and gravy, all night long. Now it's back to whatever's in the pot.

cold.li: A dream about food. Hunger, presumably. I'll eat early.

plain.li: Dreamt I was someone else, with a different name and face, and a trade I was good at.
In the dream I'd never come here. I had a small house and a dull life, and I was happy in it.
[tribal] I lived in a tower of glass, where food came out of the wall and no one ever went hunting.
[spacer] I was born a tribal hunter in my dream. Life was simple, and I knew every plant by name.
[medieval] I was a lord in a stone castle. They all bowed, and I was bored out of my skull.
[old] I dreamt I was young again, with my whole life ahead of me, and I made all the same choices.
[teen] Dreamt I was very old and they all listened when I talked. I said a lot of nonsense.
[trait:Greedy] I was rich in my dream, rooms full of silver and gold, and I still wanted more.
[again] That other life again. I'm starting to know my way around it.

warm.li: Lived another life last night, a gentler one. I'm still glad I woke up here, with all of you.

blunt.li: Was someone else all night. They had it easier.

cheerful.li: I was a famous singer in my dream! I might sing at breakfast.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the life I could have had. This one doesn't compare.

cold.li: In the dream I was a different person, and that person made better choices. Instructive.

plain.li: A huge face hung in the sky, deciding what would happen to us next. It looked bored.
Dreamt someone far off was moving us around like pieces on a board, and laughing.
A voice was telling our story to someone I couldn't see, and it kept getting the names wrong.
[trait:PsychicallySensitive|trait:PsychicallyHypersensitive] I dreamt something vast turned to look at us, the way you'd look at an anthill. Then it looked away.
[afterraid] In the dream the watcher was pleased with the fight, and wanted another.
[child] A giant was playing with us like toys, but it was being careful not to break us.
[again] The watcher again. I swear it waved this time.

blunt.li: Dreamt something up there was watching us. If it's listening, it can stop.

cheerful.li: Dreamt we were all characters in a story! I hope I'm one of the main ones.

gloomy.li: There's a thing up there watching us that enjoys it when the crops fail. I saw it last night.

cold.li: In the dream we were being observed by something that finds us entertaining. I see no reason to doubt it.

plain.li: I was the biggest person in the colony and all the grown-ups had to ask me for dessert.
Dreamt I was a grown-up and stayed up as late as I wanted, watching the fire.
I dreamt I found a door in the wall that went to a secret room only kids could fit in.
Threw the moon like a ball and it bounced all the way home.
[winter] I built a snow fort so big that all the grown-ups moved in with me.
[again] I had the secret door dream again! It's real. I just have to find it.

warm.li: It was my birthday in the dream and everyone came, and there weren't any chores.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was big. I'm still small. Not fair.

cheerful.li: I could jump right over the houses! They were all cheering.

gloomy.li: Being a grown-up in my dream was mostly chores.

cold.li: I was in charge in my dream. My rules were better.

plain.li: All the grown-ups forgot how to talk and could only make muffalo noises, and I didn't know what to do.
In my dream I got lost in the corn and it was taller than the house, and I could hear them calling but not from where.
I dreamt my shadow got up and went somewhere without me.
[night] The house was breathing, slow and deep, and only I could hear it.
[afterraid] I dreamt the bad people came back and I had to hide in the cupboard, and the cupboard was too small.
[grieving] I was looking for someone all night in my dream, in every room, and they weren't anywhere.
[again] The shadow dream again. I'm sleeping with a light on.

warm.li: I had a bad dream, but then I dreamt someone came and sat with me until it went away.

blunt.li: Bad dream. I'm not scared.

cheerful.li: I had a scary dream, but I punched the monster on the nose and it ran away crying!

gloomy.li: I had a bad dream. I don't want to go to sleep ever again.

cold.li: There was a monster in my dream. Monsters aren't real. I checked anyway.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream from the other side

plain.li: In my dream I was one of the raiders, walking up to our walls, and I could see myself at the window, aiming at me.
Lay out in the field where they fell, and heard what they were thinking. They were scared too.
[tribal] I dreamt I wore the enemy's paint and ran with them, and I didn't know which side I was on until the arrows came.
[spacer] Dreamt I was in their drop pod, coming down hard, and the one next to me was praying.
[trait:Bloodlust] I was one of them in my dream, coming at us. I didn't last long. We're good at this.
[again] I keep dreaming I'm on the wrong side of the wall. I always lose.

warm.li: I was one of the raiders, and there were people waiting for me at home. I keep thinking about that.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was one of the raiders. I didn't make it past the wall.

gloomy.li: I was one of the ones we killed. It wasn't hard to picture.

cold.li: Fought the battle from the enemy's side in my sleep. Their approach was obvious. Ours should be less so.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the butcher's table

plain.li: The meat on my plate kept trying to tell me its name. I didn't let it finish.
Back at the butcher's table in my sleep, and the knife wouldn't come clean however hard I scrubbed.
I dreamt the one we butchered was sitting at the table with us, waiting politely for a plate.
[again] The butcher's table again. Same table, same knife.

warm.li: Dreamt we gave them a proper burial. I wish that's what we'd done.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the butcher's table. Leave it.

gloomy.li: I was the one on the table in my dream, and whoever held the knife didn't hesitate.

cold.li: A dream about the butchering. My stomach turned on waking. Odd, since I felt nothing at the time.

plain.li: The body we left out there got up and came to ask why it hadn't been buried.
Dreamt the dead were standing in a line out in the field, waiting to be told where to go.
[rain] The rain was washing the bodies toward us, and they knocked on the walls.
[summer|hot] I dreamt the smell came inside and lay down in my bed, and I had to sleep next to it.
[again] The dead in the field again. They're getting impatient.

warm.li: In the dream we buried them all, ours and theirs, and said a few words over each.

blunt.li: Bodies in my dreams now. Someone bury them. I'll do it myself if I have to.

gloomy.li: Last night I was lying out there with them, and no one came.

cold.li: The corpses were in my dream. A disease risk, mostly. They should be dealt with.

plain.li: I was on trial, and the judge was the one we sent away. I stood there all night waiting for the verdict.
Dreamt the colony was a set of scales, and someone kept adding weights to the wrong side.
Someone knocked at the gate all night in my dream, asking to be let back in.
[trait:Kind] In the dream I stood up and said no, and they listened.
[again] The trial again. I still don't know the verdict.

warm.li: We found another way, in the dream. I keep thinking there must have been one.

blunt.li: Dreamt about what we did. Was it right? It's done now, either way.

gloomy.li: I dreamt they'll do the same to me one day. Maybe they should.

cold.li: A dream about the decision. I still think it was correct. The dream disagreed.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was still at the workbench, finishing something, and told me not to wait up.
Passed {OTHER_nameDef} in the hall last night and we nodded, like any other day. I didn't think anything of it until I woke.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} sat beside me and said it was all right. I almost believed it.
[winter] {OTHER_nameDef} was out in the snow, waving me over to see something. The footprints only went one way.
[again] {OTHER_nameDef} again. Same chair. I keep meaning to ask what it's like, over there.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came back to tell me it didn't hurt. I'm going to believe that.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. Still dead. Still not fair.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked me why we didn't get there sooner, and kept asking.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} appeared in my sleep. Grief, I assume. It was less unpleasant than I expected.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an old companion

plain.li: My animal came back, muddy and pleased with itself, as if it had only been out hunting.
Heard paws outside my door. I opened it, and the yard was empty and full of sun.
We were walking our old route together again, neither of us in any hurry.
[child] I dreamt my animal friend was waiting at the end of the field, and let me hold on while it ran.
[again] Paws at the door again. I keep getting up to check.

warm.li: My old companion lay down at my feet like always. I'd forgotten how warm that was.

blunt.li: Dreamt my animal came back. It didn't.

gloomy.li: Called and called in my dream, and nothing came. That part, at least, was true.

cold.li: The animal came to me in my sleep. Attachment is inconvenient. I miss it anyway.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a broken heart

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was packing a bag, and every time I unpacked it, it filled up again.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was across a river, waving, and every step I took the river got wider.
In my dream I told {OTHER_nameDef} everything I should have said. {OTHER_nameDef} just kept eating breakfast.
[rain] {OTHER_nameDef} and I were standing in the rain, and only I was getting wet.
[again] {OTHER_nameDef} again. I'd like my sleep back, please.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was happy in my dream, just not with me. I think I can live with that, in time.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm still angry.

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} never loved me at all. It made a terrible kind of sense.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} appeared in a dream. I'll consider it a temporary malfunction.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a long talk

plain.li: In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} and I kept talking after the others had gone to bed, until the sun came up.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I sat up on the roof in my dream and talked about where we'd come from.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were walking down a road that kept going, and neither of us wanted to turn back.
[winter] Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I sat up together all winter and never ran out of things to say.
[again] Talking with {OTHER_nameDef} again, in my sleep. We should do it awake more often.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} said the same kind thing in my dream that {OTHER_pronoun} really said to me. I didn't mind hearing it twice.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. We talked. It was good.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I talked the whole night through! We should do that for real.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was kind to me in my dream, the way {OTHER_pronoun} was the other day. I'm waiting for it to wear off.

cold.li: My conversation with {OTHER_nameDef} came back in a dream. Apparently it mattered to me. Interesting.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was whispering to the walls, and the walls passed it on.
In my dream I walked into the dining room and the talking stopped. {OTHER_nameDef} was smiling.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was writing something about me on every door in the colony. I couldn't read any of it.
[again] Whispers again, and {OTHER_nameDef} again. I'm starting to whisper back.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} said sorry in my dream. I'd like to think {OTHER_pronoun} meant it.

blunt.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was talking behind my back. Probably was. I'll ask.

gloomy.li: In the dream they all agreed with what {OTHER_nameDef} said about me. Maybe they do.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s remarks followed me into my sleep. I'm giving them more attention than they deserve.

plain.li: The party never ended. We were still dancing when the harvest came in.
We were all dancing, even the animals, even the ones who can't dance.
I dreamt the music kept playing after we all went to bed, and the colony danced by itself.
[child] I danced on the table in my dream, and the grown-ups clapped instead of telling me to get down!
[winter] We danced so hard the snow melted.

warm.li: Dreamt of all your faces at the celebration. I want to remember them like that.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the party. Good party.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the party went on for a week! Can we do that?

gloomy.li: In the dream the music stopped and I was cleaning up after the party alone.

cold.li: A dream about the celebration. I suppose I enjoyed it more than I let on.

plain.li: All night I was trying to sleep in a bed that kept sliding across the room.
I dreamt someone was building a house around me while I slept, and it wasn't finished by morning.
[cold|winter] I was a block of ice, and someone was carving me into a statue of myself, chip by chip.
[hot|summer] I was a loaf of bread in an oven, and someone kept opening the door to check on me.
[rain] Dreamt I was a fish, and the wet didn't bother me at all.
[large] The snoring around me turned into a choir, and I was conducting. We were terrible.
[tribal] The ground was a great animal and I was sleeping on its back. It breathed all night.
[again] Another bad night, another strange dream. I'd like a proper bed.

warm.li: Someone tucked a blanket around me in my dream. I don't know who. Thank you, whoever you are.

blunt.li: Bad sleep, weird dream. Need a real bed.

cheerful.li: My bed was a boat and I sailed it all night! A bit seasick now.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I'd never sleep properly again. My back agrees.

cold.li: Poor sleeping conditions produced an odd dream. I'd like the conditions corrected.

plain.li: My blood was full of tiny raiders, and my body was holding them off one wall at a time.
Dreamt I was a house with all the windows open, and the wind kept blowing through, and no one would close them.
The doctor was a muffalo, very gentle, breathing warm on my face while it worked.
[cold] I was sitting inside a glacier, quiet and blue, and I didn't want to leave.
[hot] Sat inside the sun all night. It was pleasant, at first.
[fever] The bed was a raft and the fever was a sea, and someone kept rowing me back to shore.
[child] The sickness was a small gray animal sitting on my chest, and it wouldn't get off.
[again] I keep dreaming my body is a fort under siege. I'm holding.

warm.li: In my dream they came to sit by my bed one at a time, each with something warm.

blunt.li: Sick. Dreamt I was sick. Even my dreams are boring.

cheerful.li: I fought the sickness with a sword! I think I'm winning.

gloomy.li: I'd been sick for years in my dream, and they'd all stopped visiting.

cold.li: My body was losing the fight, in the dream. I'd prefer it didn't.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the long dark

plain.li: Lying in a field, and the grass grew over me, slow and peaceful, until someone pulled me out.
I was at the bottom of a deep well, and I could hear them all at the top, talking about me.
I dreamt I was a candle in a big dark room, and everyone who walked past cupped their hands around me so I wouldn't go out.
[afterraid] The fight was still going on somewhere far above me, muffled, like a party in another room.
[spacer] Drifting between the stars with no suit, and it didn't matter, and the stars were singing.
[tribal] Walked the spirit road a long way, and the ancestors sent me back. They said it wasn't my time.
[child] I was very small inside a very big quiet, and then I heard someone calling me in for dinner.
[again] The long dark again. I know the way back now.

warm.li: Floating somewhere dark, and a hand kept holding mine. I think it was real.

blunt.li: Was out cold. Dreamt of nothing much, just dark. Then here.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the dark. It was quiet there. It's loud here.

cold.li: Unconscious. Fragments of a well, voices above. Nothing useful.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a lost seat

plain.li: My seat on the council had been sawn up for firewood, and they were all warming their hands over it.
Kept walking into the council chamber, and someone else was always in my seat, wearing my face.
Gave a speech to an empty room, and the room voted against me.
[again] The council dream again. Still standing at the back.

warm.li: Shook hands with whoever has my seat now, in the dream. I don't know if I meant it. Maybe one day I will.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the vote. Lost it twice. Once was enough.

gloomy.li: They were all relieved I was gone, in the dream. They were smiling about it.

cold.li: I dreamt about the vote. The next one will go differently.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a friend's betrayal

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} locked the gate behind me in my dream and walked off whistling.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} sold me to a passing trader for a handful of silver and a sack of rice.
I dreamt I was drowning and {OTHER_nameDef} was standing on the bank, deciding.
[afterraid] In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} opened the doors for the raiders and smiled at me while they came in.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} betrayed me. I know it's nonsense. I still couldn't look at {OTHER_objective} at breakfast.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sold me out last night. Only a dream, but I'm watching {OTHER_objective} today.

gloomy.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} turned on me. I wasn't even surprised.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} betrayed me in a dream. Improbable. I'll keep it in mind anyway.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I swore to look after each other, whatever came, and the words were carved into the hillside.
The world was ending, and {OTHER_nameDef} came to find me first. I'd have done the same.
We were very old, {OTHER_nameDef} and I, and still arguing about the same silly thing. I was so happy.

warm.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I made a promise to stick together. I'm keeping it, dream or no dream.

blunt.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I swore an oath. Didn't need a dream for it. Still counts.

cheerful.li: Last night {OTHER_nameDef} and I swore to be friends forever! In a dream, but I'm counting it.

gloomy.li: Lost everything in my dream except {OTHER_nameDef}. It was enough. That surprised me.

cold.li: Dreamt I would die for {OTHER_nameDef}. I've checked my reasoning. It holds.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I fought a duel with soup spoons in the middle of the dining room, until the soup went cold.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I raced to the end of the world, and {OTHER_nameDef} cut every corner.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were the last two people alive, and we still couldn't agree on anything.
[medieval] {OTHER_nameDef} and I jousted on muffalo, and the judges were all on {OTHER_possessive} side.
[again] Another duel with {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm ahead on points.

blunt.li: Dreamt I beat {OTHER_nameDef} in a fight. Fair and square. Remember that.

cheerful.li: Beat {OTHER_nameDef} at arm wrestling in my dream! I'll take it as a sign.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} won, in the dream. Of course {OTHER_pronoun} did.

cold.li: A contest with {OTHER_nameDef}, in my sleep. I lost on a technicality. That won't happen awake.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a rival's sorrow

plain.li: In my dream I found {OTHER_nameDef} crying alone in the storeroom. I didn't know {OTHER_pronoun} could.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was a child, lost and cold, and I was the only one who could see {OTHER_objective}.
Saw the world through {OTHER_nameDef}'s eyes for a day. It was harder than I thought.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was hurting, and I was the one who went to help. I don't know if I'd do it awake. I'd like to.

blunt.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was miserable. Didn't enjoy it as much as I thought I would.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was as lonely as I am, in the dream. That's not nothing.

cold.li: Saw {OTHER_nameDef} at a weak moment, in a dream. I felt sympathy instead of advantage. Irritating.

plain.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were back to back in the dark, surrounded, and I wasn't afraid at all.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I held a bridge against an army, laughing the whole time.
I dreamt I fell in the mud and {OTHER_nameDef} hauled me up without breaking stride.
[afterraid] The fight again, in my sleep, and {OTHER_nameDef} was always right where I needed {OTHER_objective}.
[tribal] Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I hunted the great beast together and shared its heart afterward.

warm.li: In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} covered me while I pulled someone out of the line of fire. That's just how it is with us.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was in a fight with {OTHER_nameDef} at my back. Good place for {OTHER_objective}.

cheerful.li: Took on a whole army with {OTHER_nameDef} last night, and we won!

cold.li: Fought alongside {OTHER_nameDef} in my sleep. Our coordination was excellent. It usually is.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a fallen comrade

plain.li: In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} went down in the fight and I didn't get there in time.
Carried {OTHER_nameDef} out of the smoke all night. Every step {OTHER_pronoun} got heavier, and I didn't put {OTHER_objective} down.
In my sleep I heard {OTHER_nameDef} calling for help over the noise of the fight, and every way I ran was the wrong way.

warm.li: Lost {OTHER_nameDef} in my dream. I've told {OTHER_objective} to keep {OTHER_possessive} head down next time.

blunt.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} died on my watch. Not happening. Not while I'm standing.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I buried {OTHER_nameDef}. I can still feel the shovel in my hands.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was killed in my dream. Unacceptable. I'll stay closer in the next fight.

plain.li: Had a dream {OTHER_nameDef} was the one teaching me {SKILL}, and I learned something I'd missed.
{OTHER_nameDef} was the best at {SKILL} anywhere in the dream, and people kept asking who taught {OTHER_objective}.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} got it wrong a hundred times and then got it right, and I cheered.
[old] I dreamt I was gone, and {OTHER_nameDef} was teaching {SKILL} to someone else, in my words. That's enough for me.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} thanked me in a dream. I haven't done enough to deserve it yet. I'll get there.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef} doing {SKILL}. Getting better. Don't say I said so.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was a master of {SKILL} in my dream, all thanks to me!

gloomy.li: In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} gave up on {SKILL}. I'll make sure that doesn't happen.

cold.li: Went over the lessons with {OTHER_nameDef} in my sleep. I'll revise the method.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a botched lesson

plain.li: I had a dream I made a mess of {SKILL} in front of {OTHER_nameDef}, and {OTHER_pronoun} just sighed and sighed.
{OTHER_nameDef} asked me a simple question about {SKILL}, and I answered in a language I don't speak.
I dreamt I had to do {SKILL} for a crowd while {OTHER_nameDef} wrote down every mistake.
[child] In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} gave me a test and all my answers were drawings of muffalo.

warm.li: Dreamt I let {OTHER_nameDef} down. I'm going to practice twice as hard.

blunt.li: Botched a lesson in my sleep. Practicing today.

cheerful.li: Set {OTHER_nameDef}'s workbench on fire in my dream! I'll be careful today.

gloomy.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} finally realized I'll never be any good at {SKILL}.

cold.li: A dream about failing a lesson with {OTHER_nameDef}. A useful warning against complacency.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was on the other side of a glass wall, talking, and I couldn't hear a word.
Dreamt I waited at the gate for {OTHER_nameDef} all night. The others all came home, but not {OTHER_objective}.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I were in different rooms of the same house, and every door I opened took me further away.
[winter] In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} went out into a blizzard to fetch something for me, and the snow closed up behind {OTHER_objective}.

warm.li: I couldn't reach {OTHER_nameDef} in my dream. This morning I made sure to find {OTHER_objective} before work.

blunt.li: Dreamt I couldn't get to {OTHER_nameDef}. Got there this morning. Problem solved.

gloomy.li: I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} finally saw me clearly and left. I keep waiting for it.

cold.li: A dream of separation from {OTHER_nameDef}. Disquieting. I'll spend more time with {OTHER_objective}.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I sat down to dinner with our whole family, even the ones neither of us ever met. They all knew our names.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were both small again, playing in a house I don't remember, with someone singing in the kitchen.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were walking back to a house that's long gone, and the lights were on.
[child] I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} carried me on {OTHER_possessive} shoulders all the way around the colony, and I could see everything.
[old] {OTHER_nameDef} was a baby again, and I was holding {OTHER_objective}, and the house was warm.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and the rest of our family were all in my dream, with no empty places at the table.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. Family. Wouldn't trade them.

cheerful.li: Had a giant family picnic in my dream with {OTHER_nameDef}, and every cousin came!

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I were the last of our family, in the dream. We are, more or less.

cold.li: A dream about {OTHER_nameDef}. Shared blood apparently means more to me than I admit.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was the only one in the colony who could see me. We didn't talk about it.
I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} told me a secret, and the secret was my own name.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were stuck on a raft together for a year. We learned a lot about each other.
In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} was building something in the dark, and wouldn't say what.
[again] {OTHER_nameDef} again. Why {OTHER_nameDef}?

warm.li: I dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm not sure what it meant, but I'm going to say good morning properly today.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. No idea why. Moving on.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} could juggle fire in my dream! I'm going to ask if {OTHER_pronoun} can.

gloomy.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was leaving and didn't say goodbye. I don't know why that bothered me so much.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was in my dream. There must be a reason. I'll pay closer attention.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a last goodbye

plain.li: Got to say goodbye to {LOST} properly this time. I said all of it, and {LOST} smiled and said, 'I know.'
{LOST} walked me across a bright field, hugged me at the far side, and went on alone. I didn't follow.
{LOST} gave me something small to keep. I woke up with my hand closed tight around nothing.
[child] {LOST} tucked me in and told me a story, and said it was all right to be happy again.
[grieving] I asked {LOST} if it hurt. {LOST} laughed and said I always worried too much.
[again] {LOST} said goodbye again last night. It's easier each time.

warm.li: I said goodbye to {LOST} last night, in a dream. I feel lighter. I think {LOST} wanted that.

blunt.li: Said goodbye to {LOST} in a dream. Should've done it while I could.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I said goodbye to {LOST}. Then I woke up and had to do it all over again.

cold.li: A dream of farewell with {LOST}. Sentimental. Apparently necessary.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a lost animal

plain.li: In the dream {PET_nameDef} ran off into the fog and wouldn't come when I called. I could hear it getting further away.
I dreamt I was looking for {PET_nameDef} everywhere, and every animal I found had the wrong face.
Dreamt {PET_nameDef} was shut outside in the snow, scratching at the door, and I couldn't find the latch.
[child] {PET_nameDef} got too big to fit through the door and had to sleep outside forever.
[afterraid] In my dream {PET_nameDef} was hurt in the fight and I couldn't find where. I went over every scratch this morning.

warm.li: Dreamt I lost {PET_nameDef}. I've been carrying treats in my pocket all morning.

blunt.li: Dreamt {PET_nameDef} went missing. Didn't. Checked.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} ran off in my dream, but only to fetch me a present!

gloomy.li: {PET_nameDef} had forgotten me, in the dream. Animals don't hold on to much.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} wandered off in my dream. I'll inspect the pens.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the hard days

plain.li: It was the first winter again, and we were eating the seed grain. My bed felt like a palace this morning.
Last night I was back in the early days, sleeping on the floor and eating out of one pot. It wasn't so bad.
[tribal] Dreamt of the lean months before this place, when we chewed bark to fool our bellies. Today's meal will taste like a feast.
[spacer] I was in the crashed pod again, rationing water a capful at a time. This place is luxury, and I'd forgotten.
[newcomer] Dreamt of the road that brought me here. I'm glad to have a roof at all.
[rich] In my dream we'd lost everything and were starting over with a few sticks and a cookpot. We managed.

warm.li: Dreamt of the hard days, when all we had was each other and one blanket between three of us.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the bad old days. Today's fine by comparison.

cheerful.li: We were starving and freezing in my dream, and then I woke up in a warm bed! What luck.

gloomy.li: I dreamt of the old hunger. It's waiting, I'm sure. But not today.

cold.li: A dream of past scarcity. It recalibrated my expectations. Useful.

plain.li: Dreamt of a shape, a curve really, and I've been seeing it everywhere since I got up. I need to make it.
I dreamt I walked through a gallery of things I haven't made yet. I remember three of them.
In the dream the stone was already a statue, and all I had to do was take away the parts that weren't.
[tribal] The ancestors painted on the cave wall beside me, and showed me the colors they'd kept hidden.

warm.li: In my dream I saw a piece I could make for the dining room, for all of us. I'm going to make it.

blunt.li: Had an idea in my sleep. Out of my way.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the most beautiful thing I've ever seen, and I'm going to make it!

gloomy.li: Something beautiful came to me in my sleep. I'd better make it before it fades like everything else.

cold.li: A complete design arrived during sleep. I'll begin before I lose the details.

plain.li: Shot at targets all night that kept running away, and hit every one. I can still feel the rhythm of it.
I dreamt I could see the wind, every gust of it, and where each shot would land.
Fought a raider in my sleep who moved exactly like me. I learned a lot about how I move.
[lowtech] In the dream I loosed arrow after arrow at a running deer, and each one went exactly where I looked.

blunt.li: Dreamt about shooting. Hit everything. Going to the range.

cheerful.li: Shot an apple off a muffalo's head in my dream! The muffalo didn't even blink.

gloomy.li: Missed every shot that mattered, in the dream. Then I took them again, one by one, until I didn't.

cold.li: I spent the night rehearsing my aim. I expect better accuracy today.

plain.li: I was a mountain, and the wind and the raiders and the winters broke against me, and I didn't move.
Dreamt I stood in the gate alone, and everything that came at it turned back.
I dreamt my bones were made of iron. I can still feel them.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] My fear was a small animal, and I picked it up and put it in my pocket. It's still in there, keeping quiet.
[afterraid] The next attack came in my dream, and I was ready for it. I still am.

warm.li: I was standing between the colony and the dark, and everyone I love was behind me. I wasn't afraid.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was a mountain. Feel like one. Bring it.

cheerful.li: I was a mountain last night! I still feel like one.

gloomy.li: Nothing could hurt me in the dream. It won't last, but I'll take today.

cold.li: A dream of being immovable. My nerves have settled. Good.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the council fire

plain.li: In my dream the council sat around one big fire, and every voice was heard, even the quiet ones.
Dreamt the council chamber had no walls, and anyone could walk in and say their piece.
I dreamt we voted on something hard and everyone agreed, and then we all went to dinner together.
[trusting] The council kept every promise it ever made, in my dream. I think it might really be trying.
[tribal] The elders sat in a ring and spoke for all of us, and the spirits nodded along.

warm.li: Dreamt of the council, all of us together, deciding things kindly. We can be like that.

blunt.li: Dreamt the council got something right. Fine. I'll give them a chance.

cheerful.li: Had a dream our council was the best in the world! Maybe it is.

gloomy.li: The council was fair to everyone in my dream. Maybe that's not as far off as I think.

cold.li: A dream of a functional council. Unusual. I'll extend some provisional trust.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the empty chamber

plain.li: The council chamber was empty, and the wind was making the decisions.
I dreamt I brought a petition to the council, and they folded it into a paper bird and threw it into the fire.
Dreamt the council all wore masks, and under the masks were more masks.
[bitter|doubtful] In the dream the council had decided everything years ago, and we were all just acting it out.
[again] The empty chamber again. The wind is still in charge.

warm.li: In my dream the council had forgotten all of us. I hope that's not true.

blunt.li: Dreamt the council was a row of empty chairs. Not much different.

gloomy.li: No one was in charge at all, in my dream. I'm not sure it was a dream.

cold.li: A dream of an absent council. Possibly accurate. I'll watch them more closely.

plain.li: My room had turned into a garden overnight, with vines over the bed and flowers on the windowsill.
I dreamt I woke up next to a plant that had grown all night just to say good morning.
[winter] Dreamt it was spring inside my room while the snow fell outside, all from one pot by the window.

warm.li: Dreamt of green things growing beside my bed. I'd like that. Something living to look after.

blunt.li: Dreamt of plants in my room. Want one. That's all.

cheerful.li: My room was a jungle in my dream! I want a plant. Maybe two.

gloomy.li: I dreamt of a garden. Then I woke up to bare walls.

cold.li: Greenery in my quarters, in the dream. The preference is clear. I'll raise it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the white giant

plain.li: A pale giant with a single horn walked along the edge of the world, slow as a cloud. It never looked our way.
I dreamt something huge and gentle passed the colony in the night, and the ground was warm where it stepped.
[tribal] The great white spirit walked past our fires, and the elders said not to anger it.

warm.li: Something old and kind walked past us in the night and wished us well. I hope it comes back.

cheerful.li: A giant white beast with a horn walked by in my dream! It looked so soft.

cold.li: Dreamt of an enormous white animal. Valuable, and dangerous. I'd leave it be.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the burning stone

plain.li: In my dream a stone fell out of the sky, burning, and when it cooled it was full of shining veins.
I dreamt the sky threw a rock at us. It missed, on purpose I think, and left us a gift.
[tribal] The sky spirits dropped a burning stone into our valley, and when the elders cracked it open it was full of metal.

warm.li: Dreamt a star fell near us and didn't hurt anyone. It just wanted to be close.

cold.li: A dream of a meteor strike. Statistically unlikely. I'd still keep clear of open ground for a few days.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the broken ship

plain.li: Pieces of a great ship were raining down, each one humming a different song.
I dreamt a ship far above us broke apart like a dropped plate, and some of it came down here.
[spacer] Dreamt of an old ship dying in orbit, coming apart piece by piece. I recognized the sound.
[tribal] The iron birds fought in the sky in my dream, and one of them fell to pieces over our hills.

gloomy.li: Dreamt a ship broke apart overhead. Whoever was on it never made it down.

cold.li: I dreamt of falling wreckage. Salvage, if it lands somewhere convenient.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the sweet grove

plain.li: A grove grew up overnight, with fruit that tasted like laughing.
I dreamt I followed a sweet smell into the trees and found everyone from the colony there, eating and singing.
[trait:ChemicalInterest|trait:ChemicalFascination] Dreamt of a fruit that made everything feel right, growing wild somewhere close. I can almost smell it.

warm.li: The land gave us something sweet in my dream, just because. I'll keep an eye out.

cheerful.li: Magic fruit was growing just outside the walls in my dream! Let's go and look.

cold.li: A fruit with pleasant effects, growing nearby. I saw it in a dream. Worth investigating.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the mad eyes

plain.li: In the dream the animals came out of the trees together, all running the same way, with madness in their eyes.
I dreamt every animal in the forest woke up angry, and they all knew where we lived.
[skill:Animals] Tried to calm a herd in my dream, and every one of them looked at me with someone else's eyes.

blunt.li: Dreamt of animals coming for us. Mad ones. Keep the doors shut.

gloomy.li: Dreamt even the animals hate us now. Maybe they always did.

cold.li: A dream of a stampede aimed at the colony. Keep the doors closed for a few days. It costs nothing.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the silent machines

plain.li: Every machine in the colony held its breath, and the lights went out, and the sun was laughing.
I dreamt the sun reached down and pressed its thumb on everything that hums.
[tribal|medieval] The sun grew angry at the strangers' machines in my dream and struck them all dumb.

blunt.li: Dreamt the power died. All of it. Charge what you can.

cheerful.li: Dreamt all the machines took a nap at the same time! Even they need a rest.

cold.li: Dreamt every light and machine went dead. I'd make sure nothing vital depends on power for the next few days.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the closed eye

plain.li: In my dream the sun closed its eye in the middle of the day, and everything went quiet and gray.
I dreamt someone hung a blanket over the sky, and the crops looked up and waited.
[tribal] The great wolf swallowed the sun and wouldn't give it back for days.

cheerful.li: It was night in the daytime in my dream! A whole day of bedtime stories.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the sun turned its back on us. Fitting.

cold.li: I dreamt of darkness at midday. Bad for the crops, bad for solar power. I'd plan accordingly.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the burning wind

plain.li: A hot wind came and didn't stop, and the birds walked instead of flying.
I dreamt the sun came down to live with us for a while, and it didn't know how to be a quiet guest.
[old] Dreamt of a summer so hot it cracked the riverbed. I've lived through one like that before.

blunt.li: Dreamt it got hot. Really hot. Find some shade.

cheerful.li: It was so hot in my dream we cooked eggs on the roof! Free breakfast.

cold.li: Dreamt of a heat that wouldn't break. I'd check the shade and the water.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the feathered hat

plain.li: I dreamt lots of people came to visit, and one of them had a hat with a feather in it, and they were nice to me.
In my dream strangers walked up to our gate waving, and they had stories, and no one had to fight.
We had guests in my dream, and the grown-ups were all on their best behavior. It was funny.

cheerful.li: Visitors came in my dream and they brought sweets! I'm going to wait by the gate.

gloomy.li: People came to visit in my dream and none of them talked to me. Maybe they will this time.

cold.li: I dreamt of visitors. I'm going to watch them very carefully when they come.
